npcs.name: Victor
npcs.searchTags: victor mayor city hall contracts power water land rust rumbling bench
npcs.zhSearchTags: Victor 维克托 市长 市政厅 合同 电力 水 土地 修车 工作台
npcs.summary: Sunvale's Mayor and the current-build contact for ranch utility contracts and additional land.
npcs.zhSummary: Sunvale 市长，也是当前版本办理牧场水电合同和购买额外土地的联系人。
npcs.whenNeeded: Look for Victor when you need a utility contract, additional land or the observed electricity-to-workbench route.
npcs.zhWhenNeeded: 需要办理水电合同、购买额外土地，或按已记录路线推进电力与工作台时查找 Victor。

facts.text: Current-build footage identifies Victor as Sunvale's Mayor and shows his conversation at City Hall.
facts.zhText: 当前版本视频将 Victor 标为 Sunvale 市长，并记录了他在市政厅的对话。

facts.text: His current dialogue offers electricity and gas, water, and additional-land options.
facts.zhText: 他当前的对话选项包括电力与燃气合同、水合同和购买额外土地。

facts.text: The observed Power to the Bench route sends the player to Victor for the electricity contract before building and checking a workbench.
facts.zhText: 视频中的 Power to the Bench 流程要求玩家先找 Victor 签电力合同，再建造并检查工作台。

npcs.name: Angela
npcs.searchTags: angela chicken seller coop heater ac animal shop field
npcs.zhSearchTags: Angela 安吉拉 鸡 商人 鸡舍 暖气 空调 动物商店 围栏
npcs.summary: The chicken seller tied to the coop mission, bird pickup and the correct coop climate equipment.
npcs.zhSummary: 养鸡任务相关商人，负责出售鸡以及可用于鸡舍的正确温控设备。
npcs.whenNeeded: Look for Angela when you are buying the first chicken, trying to bring a purchased bird home or checking which climate equipment belongs in animal housing.
npcs.zhWhenNeeded: 第一次买鸡、需要把买到的鸡带回家，或要确认动物建筑该用哪种温控设备时查找 Angela。

facts.text: Current players identify Angela as the chicken seller used by the coop mission.
facts.zhText: 当前玩家资料将 Angela 指认为养鸡任务中的卖鸡商人。

facts.text: Purchased chickens appear in the fenced field behind her house rather than in the player's inventory; carry them or load them into a car boot.
facts.zhText: 购买的鸡会出现在她屋后的围栏地里，而不是玩家背包中；需要抱走或装进汽车后备箱。

facts.text: Official support context identifies Angela's coop/barn heater and AC as the functional versions; City Hall decoration units do not work for animal housing.
facts.zhText: 官方支持语境确认，应购买 Angela 出售的鸡舍/畜棚暖气和空调；市政厅的家用装饰版本对动物建筑无效。

npcs.name: Gigi
npcs.searchTags: gigi real eggs evidence large egg police chase quest home
npcs.zhSearchTags: Gigi 吉吉 大鸡蛋 真实鸡蛋 证据 警察 追逐 任务 回家
npcs.summary: The NPC at the center of the current large-egg quest and its police-chase return route.
npcs.zhSummary: 当前大鸡蛋任务及随后警察追逐、送回家流程的核心 NPC。
npcs.whenNeeded: Look for Gigi when the large-egg handoff or the documented police-chase return route is your current task; the retained evidence does not establish a follow-up quest.
npcs.zhWhenNeeded: 当前目标是交付大鸡蛋或完成已记录的警察追逐送回路线时查找 Gigi；现有证据没有确认后续任务。

facts.text: An official moderator reply identifies the two-egg hand-in as the end of the main questline for now; this does not catalogue optional or unrelated quests.
facts.zhText: 官方版主回复确认，交付两枚鸡蛋后当前主线暂时结束；这不等于已经编目所有可选或无关任务。

facts.text: The current quest route asks for two Large Eggs before the next handoff becomes available.
facts.zhText: 当前任务流程要求先准备两个大鸡蛋，之后才会出现下一步交付。

facts.text: After the egg handoff, Gigi follows the player through a police escape and must be returned to her home area to finish the documented route.
facts.zhText: 交付鸡蛋后，Gigi 会跟随玩家经历逃离警察的流程，并需要被送回她家附近才能完成已记录路线。

facts.text: Multiple current players report no implemented follow-up quest after this route; treat it as the present story endpoint, not a hidden trigger with a known solution.
facts.zhText: 多名当前玩家报告此流程后没有已实装的后续任务；现阶段应视为剧情终点，而不是存在已知隐藏触发条件。

npcs.name: Malcolm
npcs.searchTags: malcolm shop catalogue merchant vendor items
npcs.zhSearchTags: Malcolm 马尔科姆 商店 商品 目录 商人
npcs.summary: A build-defined merchant contact whose dialogue can open a shop catalogue after an availability check.
npcs.zhSummary: 构建内记录的商人联系人；其对话会先检查商人可用性，再提供打开商店目录的路线。
npcs.whenNeeded: Check Malcolm when a quest or conversation sends you to his shop; the retained build does not identify the catalogue contents or opening hours.
npcs.zhWhenNeeded: 任务或对话要求前往 Malcolm 的商店时查找此条目；保留构建没有列出目录内容或营业时间。

facts.text: A Malcolm-named conversation exposes a View shop items action.
facts.zhText: 以 Malcolm 命名的对话提供“查看商店商品”操作。

facts.text: The shop branch is preceded by a merchant-availability condition rather than an unconditional catalogue action.
facts.zhText: 商店分支前存在商人可用性条件，并不是无条件打开目录。

facts.text: The retained nodes do not identify inventory, prices, hours or a guaranteed current runtime location.
facts.zhText: 保留节点没有确认库存、价格、营业时间或当前运行时必定出现的位置。

npcs.name: Meriam
npcs.searchTags: meriam blueprint catalogue sell inventory merchant shop
npcs.zhSearchTags: Meriam 米里亚姆 蓝图 目录 出售 背包 商店
npcs.summary: A build-defined merchant contact connected to a blueprint catalogue and selling items from the player's inventory.
npcs.zhSummary: 构建内记录的商人联系人，关联蓝图目录以及从玩家背包出售物品的操作。
npcs.whenNeeded: Check Meriam when you need the dialogue path for blueprints or selling carried items; contents and prices remain unverified.
npcs.zhWhenNeeded: 需要通过对话寻找蓝图或出售随身物品时查找 Meriam；目录内容和价格仍未验证。

facts.text: Meriam-named dialogue exposes an action that opens a blueprint catalogue.
facts.zhText: 以 Meriam 命名的对话提供打开蓝图目录的操作。

facts.text: A separate branch exposes selling items from the player's inventory.
facts.zhText: 另一条分支提供从玩家背包出售物品的操作。

facts.text: The retained dialogue does not enumerate blueprint contents, prices, opening hours or current runtime availability.
facts.zhText: 保留对话没有列出蓝图内容、价格、营业时间或当前运行时可用性。

npcs.name: Country mechanic
npcs.searchTags: country mechanic repair vehicle catalogue funds price quickfix
npcs.zhSearchTags: 乡村维修商 车辆 修理 目录 资金 价格 QuickFix
npcs.summary: The build-defined service contact for a vehicle catalogue branch and the repair-all dialogue path.
npcs.zhSummary: 构建内记录的车辆服务联系人，关联商品目录分支和全部修理对话路线。
npcs.whenNeeded: Use this contact when a vehicle needs repair or the country-mechanic catalogue; the total repair cost is filled at runtime.
npcs.zhWhenNeeded: 车辆需要修理或要查乡村维修商目录时使用此条目；修理总价由运行时填入。

facts.text: Country-mechanic dialogue exposes a catalogue action behind a merchant-availability condition.
facts.zhText: 乡村维修商对话在商人可用性条件后提供商品目录操作。

facts.text: The repair path checks for repairable vehicle content and sufficient player funds before invoking a repair-all action.
facts.zhText: 修理路线会先检查可修理车辆内容和玩家资金是否足够，再调用全部修理操作。

facts.text: The displayed repair total is runtime-filled; the retained nodes do not establish one fixed repair price or current stock.
facts.zhText: 显示的修理总价由运行时填入；保留节点不能证明统一固定价格或当前库存。

npcs.name: Susan
npcs.searchTags: susan animal infection treatment antibiotics rest veterinarian funds
npcs.zhSearchTags: Susan 苏珊 动物 感染 治疗 抗生素 休息 资金
npcs.summary: A build-defined animal-treatment contact whose dialogue describes infection care and a runtime-priced treatment path.
npcs.zhSummary: 构建内记录的动物治疗联系人；其对话描述感染护理和运行时计价的治疗路线。
npcs.whenNeeded: Check Susan when an animal is infected and the treatment dialogue asks for antibiotics, rest or payment.
npcs.zhWhenNeeded: 动物感染、治疗对话提到抗生素、休息或付款时查找 Susan。

facts.text: Susan's treatment path describes an animal infection that needs antibiotics and rest.
facts.zhText: Susan 的治疗路线描述动物感染后需要抗生素和休息。

facts.text: The dialogue checks a runtime-filled treatment total and whether the player has enough funds.
facts.zhText: 对话会检查运行时填入的治疗总价以及玩家资金是否足够。

facts.text: The path invokes a shared repair-all action; the retained build does not provide one fixed treatment price or prove the outcome was runtime-tested.
facts.zhText: 该路线会调用共用的全部修复操作；保留构建没有提供统一固定治疗价格，也不能证明结果已经运行时实测。
